lines.zh: 金黄的鳞划开水面，我贴着岸边游。
lines.en: Golden scales cut the water as I swim by the bank.

lines.zh: 阳光落进水底，我跟着那道光走。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches the riverbed, and I follow that beam.

lines.zh: 芦苇根间空隙多，我从缝里钻过去。
lines.en: The reed roots have gaps, and I slip through them.

lines.zh: 我一路游一路晃，黄鳞像碎金。
lines.en: I swim and sway, my yellow scales like broken gold.

lines.zh: 泥沙扬起又落下，我早游远了。
lines.en: Silt rises and settles, but I am already far.

lines.zh: 河水浅处发暖，我偏要往那边靠。
lines.en: The shallows feel warm, so I drift that way.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，岸边的水纹就散开。
lines.en: One tail flick, and the ripples by the bank spread out.

lines.zh: 绕过那截沉木，我进了下游的湾。
lines.en: Rounding that sunken log, I enter the downstream bend.

lines.zh: 我游成一条金线，穿过整片浅滩。
lines.en: I swim as a gold thread across the whole shoal.

lines.zh: 水面有落叶，我从它下面过去。
lines.en: A leaf floats above; I pass beneath it.

lines.zh: 泥底太软，我改走石头那边。
lines.en: The mud is too soft, so I take the stony side.

lines.zh: 我顺着石壁往前，鳞上贴了青苔。
lines.en: I follow the stone wall, moss clinging to my scales.

lines.zh: 太阳斜了，我往有光的水层上浮。
lines.en: The sun slants, so I rise toward the lit water.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块黄石头转，差点认错。
lines.en: I circle a yellow stone and almost mistake it for kin.

lines.zh: 我在水草根边慢慢转，鳍不乱摆。
lines.en: I turn slowly by the weed roots, fins steady.

lines.zh: 我身上这块黄宝石，别惦记。
lines.en: Don't get any ideas about this yellow gem on me.

lines.zh: 停在水里，我像一枚落下去的金币。
lines.en: Hovering, I look like a coin dropped in water.

lines.zh: 黄鳞映着光，自己就亮了起来。
lines.en: My yellow scales catch the light and glow on their own.

lines.zh: 我不动，让水流替我摆尾。
lines.en: I stay still and let the current wag my tail.

lines.zh: 泥面上有几个小坑，是我昨天留下的。
lines.en: Little pits in the mud — I left them yesterday.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进草里，只留背鳍在外。
lines.en: I bury my head in the weeds, dorsal fin showing.

lines.zh: 水底的光一格一格移，我看得发呆。
lines.en: Light on the riverbed shifts square by square; I stare.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己有几片鳞，就放弃了。
lines.en: I cannot count my own scales, so I give up.

lines.zh: 一只螺爬过石头，我让它先走。
lines.en: A snail crosses the stone; I let it go first.

lines.zh: 我呼吸很慢，水面几乎不起泡。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, barely raising a bubble.

lines.zh: 水凉下来，我把自己缩成一团金。
lines.en: The water cools, and I curl into a knot of gold.

lines.zh: 有片鳞翘起来了，我用石头蹭平。
lines.en: A scale sticks up, so I rub it flat on a stone.

lines.zh: 这处河湾没有别人，很合我意。
lines.en: No one else shares this bend, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，什么也没吃到。
lines.en: I open my mouth and close it, having eaten nothing.

lines.zh: 我像块黄石头一样，待了很久很久。
lines.en: Like a yellow stone, I stay a very long time.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，影子正好落在我头上。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank, and your shadow lands on me.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在反光，比我还亮。
lines.en: The thing in your hand glints brighter than I do.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你一直没走。
lines.en: I look at you because you have not left.

lines.zh: 黄鳞被你看得发烫，我游开一点。
lines.en: Your gaze makes my yellow scales hot; I swim off.

lines.zh: 别把我当成水里的金子。
lines.en: Do not mistake me for gold in the water.

lines.zh: 你的影子一动，我的鳍就收起来。
lines.en: Your shadow moves, and my fins fold in.

lines.zh: 我在水里，你在岸上，这样正好。
lines.en: I am in the water and you on the bank — that is fine.

lines.zh: 你伸下来的手，比石头热得多。
lines.en: The hand you reach down is far hotter than stone.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛跟着我，我就不敢停。
lines.en: Your eyes follow me, so I dare not stop.

lines.zh: 我躲在黄泥后面，你还能看见我吗？
lines.en: I hide behind yellow mud — can you still see me?

lines.zh: 疼，我的黄鳞掉进泥里了。
lines.en: It hurts — a yellow scale fell into the mud.

lines.zh: 你打得不重，可我还是想跑。
lines.en: Your blow was light, but I still want to run.

lines.zh: 我钻进草根，别把手伸进来。
lines.en: I dive into the roots; do not reach in after me.

lines.zh: 两下我就撑不住了，你收手吧。
lines.en: Two hits and I am done for — please stop.

lines.zh: 水被我搅浑，正好遮住我的伤。
lines.en: I muddy the water, and it hides my wound.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴僵了，游起来一瘸一拐。
lines.en: My tail has gone stiff; I swim lopsided.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住了岸上的人。
lines.en: This blow taught me about the people on the bank.

lines.zh: 我贴在石头上，疼得不敢动。
lines.en: I press against the stone, hurting too much to move.

lines.zh: 别追了，我身上只有几片鳞。
lines.en: Stop chasing; all I have is a few scales.

lines.zh: 我逃得很慢，你得给我时间。
lines.en: I flee slowly; you must give me time.

lines.zh: 你手心里那点碎食，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the crumbs in your palm.

lines.zh: 金色的东西落水，我总是先过去。
lines.en: When something golden falls in, I always go first.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我不敢离石头太远。
lines.en: I am hungry, yet I dare not stray far from the stone.

lines.zh: 那虫子扭了一下，我就往前挪了一寸。
lines.en: The worm wriggles once, and I creep an inch closer.

lines.zh: 食物在水面打转，我抬头等着。
lines.en: Food spins on the surface; I wait with my head up.

lines.zh: 你要是再丢一块，我就真的过来了。
lines.en: Drop one more piece and I will truly come over.

lines.zh: 这点腥味，够我惦记一整天。
lines.en: This faint smell will keep me thinking all day.

lines.zh: 我绕了两圈，还是没忍住。
lines.en: I circled twice and still could not resist.

lines.zh: 亮的东西和吃的，我分不太清。
lines.en: Bright things and food — I cannot quite tell them apart.

lines.zh: 我张嘴等着，水面却什么也没有。
lines.en: I wait with my mouth open, but the surface brings nothing.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边擦过，鳞都蹭掉了。
lines.en: I brushed past your leg and lost a scale.

lines.zh: 谁把石头挪到这里了？我撞得头晕。
lines.en: Who moved this stone here? My head is spinning.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我从你脚边过去。
lines.en: Stand still and I will pass by your feet.

lines.zh: 这一撞，水底的泥全起来了。
lines.en: That collision stirred up all the mud below.

lines.zh: 我游得急，撞上你的靴尖。
lines.en: I swam too fast and struck your boot tip.

lines.zh: 黄鳞不结实，碰一下就花。
lines.en: Yellow scales are not tough; one bump scuffs them.

lines.zh: 我不是要撞你，是水流推的。
lines.en: I did not mean to hit you; the current pushed me.

lines.zh: 两块石头中间太窄，我卡了一下。
lines.en: The gap between two stones was tight; I stuck briefly.

lines.zh: 你挪开一点，我就能游过去了。
lines.en: Move aside a little and I can swim through.

lines.zh: 撞完我绕了个圈，又回到原处。
lines.en: After the bump I circled and came back to the same spot.

lines.zh: 你的鳞也是黄的，那我们是一对。
lines.en: Your scales are yellow too, so we are a pair.

lines.zh: 我在芦苇下等你，水不深，很暖。
lines.en: I wait beneath the reeds; the water is shallow and warm.

lines.zh: 两条黄鱼并排游，谁也看不见谁。
lines.en: Two yellow fish side by side, neither seeing the other.

lines.zh: 这块鹅卵石够大，容得下我们俩。
lines.en: This cobble is big enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 你游前面，我跟着你的尾痕。
lines.en: Swim ahead, and I will follow your tail's trail.

lines.zh: 我们的窝就在那丛草根里，记好了。
lines.en: Our nest is in that clump of roots — remember it.

lines.zh: 我不太会说话，只会绕着你转。
lines.en: I am not much for words; I only circle you.

lines.zh: 你若被冲走，我会顺着水找。
lines.en: If you are swept away, I will search downstream.

lines.zh: 金光落在我们身上，像一层薄纱。
lines.en: Gold light falls on us like a thin veil.

lines.zh: 别急，我们还有很多个河湾要走。
lines.en: No hurry — we have many bends left to travel.

lines.zh: 我衔起一颗黄石子，又吐掉了。
lines.en: I pick up a yellow pebble, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 这东西比我想的沉，差点沉下去。
lines.en: This is heavier than I thought; it nearly dragged me down.

lines.zh: 我把它藏在草根底下，谁也找不到。
lines.en: I hide it under the roots where no one can find it.

lines.zh: 嘴太小，我只能含住一半。
lines.en: My mouth is too small; I can hold only half.

lines.zh: 你掉的碎屑，我一片片收起来。
lines.en: The crumbs you dropped — I gather them one by one.

lines.zh: 亮东西进了嘴，我才发现不能吃。
lines.en: The bright thing entered my mouth before I knew it was inedible.

lines.zh: 我用鳍把它拨到石头缝里。
lines.en: I nudge it into the stone crevice with my fin.

lines.zh: 捡了又丢，我玩了一整个下午。
lines.en: I picked it up and dropped it all afternoon.

lines.zh: 这块最黄，我要放在窝边上。
lines.en: This one is the yellowest; I will put it by the nest.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，游起来歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My mouth is stuffed, so I swim crookedly.

lines.zh: 岸上有脚步，我停下来听。
lines.en: Footsteps on the bank; I stop to listen.

lines.zh: 一个影子压过来，比石头还大。
lines.en: A shadow bears down, larger than any stone.

lines.zh: 水草忽然不动了，我警觉起来。
lines.en: The weeds suddenly still, and I grow alert.

lines.zh: 有根竿子伸进水里，我盯着它。
lines.en: A rod dips into the water, and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 那边的水响了，不是鱼的声音。
lines.en: The water sounds over there — not a fish's sound.

lines.zh: 我看见网的一角，心就沉下去。
lines.en: I glimpse a corner of the net and my heart sinks.

lines.zh: 一条陌生的鱼闯进来，我先退。
lines.en: An unfamiliar fish intrudes; I back off first.

lines.zh: 水面破了，有什么东西下来。
lines.en: The surface breaks; something is coming down.

lines.zh: 我认得那种脚步，是人的。
lines.en: I know that kind of step — it belongs to a person.

lines.zh: 一道黄影掠过，我以为是同伴。
lines.en: A yellow flash passes; I take it for a companion.

lines.zh: 我躲在黄泥里，只露两只眼。
lines.en: I hide in the yellow mud with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 它在那里等着，我就一直不动。
lines.en: It waits there, so I simply do not move.

lines.zh: 我盯着那条网的边，找缺口。
lines.en: I study the net's edge, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 它往前走一步，我就退半尺。
lines.en: It takes a step forward; I retreat half a foot.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子是我的方向标。
lines.en: The shadow on the surface tells me which way to go.

lines.zh: 我算着距离，等它先失去耐心。
lines.en: I gauge the distance and wait for it to lose patience.

lines.zh: 那块石头的背面，是我要去的。
lines.en: The far side of that stone is where I need to be.

lines.zh: 我不看它的脸，只看它的脚。
lines.en: I do not watch its face, only its feet.

lines.zh: 我的黄鳞在暗处，反而好藏。
lines.en: My yellow scales hide better in the dark.

lines.zh: 它若伸手，我就往草最密处钻。
lines.en: If it reaches in, I dive where the weeds are thickest.

lines.zh: 我咬你的指尖，只轻轻一下。
lines.en: I bite your fingertip — only lightly.

lines.zh: 别捏我，我用头撞你的掌心。
lines.en: Do not squeeze me; I butt your palm with my head.

lines.zh: 这一撞没什么力气，你别笑。
lines.en: This bump has no strength behind it; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 你抓我尾巴，我就回头咬。
lines.en: Grab my tail and I turn to bite.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，可我还是会撞。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, and still I will ram.

lines.zh: 我的牙只够咬断一根水草。
lines.en: My teeth can barely bite through a single weed.

lines.zh: 疼的是我，你却先叫起来。
lines.en: I am the one hurting, yet you cry out first.

lines.zh: 就一下，然后我立刻游走。
lines.en: Just one hit, and then I swim away at once.

lines.zh: 我发脾气时，黄鳞会竖起几片。
lines.en: When I lose my temper, a few yellow scales stand up.

lines.zh: 这一下是警告，下次我咬得更准。
lines.en: This is a warning; next time I bite truer.

lines.zh: 河水刚暖起来，我就出现在浅湾。
lines.en: The river just warmed, and I appear in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我从泥里翻出来，甩掉一身黄泥。
lines.en: I roll out of the mud and shake off the yellow clay.

lines.zh: 芦苇荡多了水，我就有了地方住。
lines.en: The reeds filled with water, so I found a home.

lines.zh: 这一带水色发黄，正合我的鳞。
lines.en: The water here runs yellow — just right for my scales.

lines.zh: 我出生在鹅卵石之间，第一口是泥味。
lines.en: Born among cobbles, my first taste was mud.

lines.zh: 河湾安静下来，我才敢露面。
lines.en: Only when the bend quieted did I dare show myself.

lines.zh: 我这条黄鱼，是从石缝里挤出来的。
lines.en: This yellow fish squeezed out of a stone's crack.

lines.zh: 有水，有草，有石，我就活下来了。
lines.en: Water, weeds, stones — and I survive.

lines.zh: 阳光照进浅水，我顺势浮上来。
lines.en: Sunlight enters the shallows, and I rise with it.

lines.zh: 别问我是谁生的，我只知道河。
lines.en: Do not ask who bore me; I only know the river.

lines.zh: 水里着火，烫得我直打转。
lines.en: Fire in the water — the heat spins me in circles.

lines.zh: 我在半空里翻了个身，摔进泥里。
lines.en: I tumbled through the air and landed in the mud.

lines.zh: 我的鳃堵住了，水也救不了我。
lines.en: My gills are clogged; even water cannot save me.

lines.zh: 河湾被炸开，我的窝也没了。
lines.en: The bend is blown open, and my nest is gone.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，钉在我旁边。
lines.en: An arrow shot into the water sticks beside me.

lines.zh: 那股怪力把我从水里提了起来。
lines.en: That strange force lifts me right out of the water.

lines.zh: 饿到鳞都松了，我还是找不到吃的。
lines.en: Starved until my scales loosen, and still no food.

lines.zh: 雷电顺着水面爬过来，我鳞全麻了。
lines.en: Lightning crawls along the surface and numbs my scales.

lines.zh: 河底裂开，下面什么也没有。
lines.en: The riverbed splits, and there is nothing beneath.
